editorial:
Imagine moving to a quiet, sleepy town with your mom, only to find out the place is hiding a dark secret. You follow a young woman who thinks she is just starting over, but she quickly realizes she is not alone. A ghost of a teenager starts appearing to her, and it is clear that this spirit wants something. The vibe is very moody and mysterious, making you feel like something bad is lurking just around the corner in every single scene. It is a slow burn that builds up a lot of tension as you try to figure out why the town is so secretive.

The acting is solid and makes the scary moments feel real. While the pacing is a bit slow at times, the big twists make the wait worth it. If you like mysteries that keep you guessing until the very end, you will love this one. You can find this as a digital rental on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a movie collector, you might want to hunt down the physical DVD for your shelf. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend when you want a spooky story that is not too over the top.
endingExplained: You find out that the ghost was a girl who was murdered years ago by people in the town who wanted to protect their own reputations. The main character discovers the truth through clues the ghost left behind. In the end, the killer is finally caught and brought to justice. Once the truth is out in the open, the ghost finds peace and disappears, allowing the main character to finally live in the town without fear.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves small-town secrets and supernatural mysteries.
